speaker: Unknown
en: So we are actually proving you that the vulnerabilities that we are finding are actually exploitable, and we just flag them as bugs.
zh: 所以我们实际上是在向你证明，我们发现的漏洞确实是可利用的，然后我们才把它们标记为 bug。

speaker: Unknown
en: We actually have to prove that they are
zh: 我们实际上必须证明它们是

speaker: Unknown
en: Exploitable.
zh: 可利用的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we take context for many different machines and for many different environments, and we combine them together to help guide our LLMs.
zh: 我们从许多不同的机器、许多不同的环境中获取上下文，并把它们结合起来，用来引导我们的 LLM。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is what we're doing differently, and I think this is really what makes this solution so unique and so well positioned to the fact that each one of us have a few coding gadgets running in production and pushing more code than ever.
zh: 这就是我们在做的与众不同之处，我认为这正是让这个解决方案如此独特、如此契合现状的原因——现在我们每个人都有一堆编码小工具在生产环境中运行，并且推送的代码比以往任何时候都多。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, how do we do it?
zh: 那么，我们是怎么做到的呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: How does it work behind the scenes?
zh: 幕后是如何运作的？

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, so what I want you to understand is we are not taking the static scanners or the dust scanners and just combining with LLM, okay?
zh: 好，我希望你明白的一点是，我们并不是拿静态扫描器或 dust 扫描器，然后简单地跟 LLM 拼在一起，明白吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: We build it from the ground up using LLM.
zh: 我们是用 LLM 从零开始构建的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we have a series of a few agents working together.
zh: 我们有一系列智能体在协同工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first one is the LLM orchestrator, okay?
zh: 第一个是 LLM 编排器，明白吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Imagine it as the brain.
zh: 你可以把它想象成大脑。

speaker: Unknown
en: This agent is working according to a dynamic plan that it follows and he knows how to operate all the different sub-agents.
zh: 这个智能体按照它所遵循的动态计划工作，并且它知道如何操作所有不同的子智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first agent, or actually the second agent, is the recon.
zh: 第一个智能体，其实是第二个智能体，是 recon。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can imagine it as your elite intelligence unit.
zh: 你可以把它想象成你的精英情报部队。

speaker: Unknown
en: The idea is to collect all the data it can about the different network endpoints, the different APIs, the different fingerprints, collect all of this data together.
zh: 它的理念是收集它能收集到的关于不同网络端点、不同 API、不同指纹的所有数据，把所有这些数据汇总到一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: Formalize an architecture out of that and hand it to the next agent.
zh: 从中形式化出一个架构，并交给下一个智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the next agent is the vulnerability testing.
zh: 下一个智能体是漏洞测试。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's actually, again, a series of a few specialized agents.
zh: 实际上，它又是一系列专门化的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some of them are targeting the well-known classes of vulnerabilities.
zh: 其中一些针对众所周知类别的漏洞。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some of them are actually hunting for vulnerabilities in the wild.
zh: 另一些则实际在野外搜寻漏洞。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they are trying to break your application to understand the business context and to understand where an attacker can get from.
zh: 它们试图攻破你的应用程序，以理解业务上下文，并理解攻击者能从哪里入手。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then they hand it into the judge, as I like to call it, the exploit validation.
zh: 然后它们把它交给我喜欢称之为法官的东西，也就是漏洞利用验证。

speaker: Unknown
en: So actually, every vulnerability that the previous agents find are now being handed over to this judge.
zh: 所以实际上，前面的智能体找到的每一个漏洞，现在都会被移交给这个法官。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the goal of the judge is to tell us whether this is a real vulnerability or not, to tell us whether this can be exploitable or not, exactly because we want to reduce the cognitive load, exactly because we want to reduce
zh: 法官的目标是告诉我们这到底是不是一个真实的漏洞，告诉我们这是否可被利用，正是因为我们想要降低认知负担，正是因为我们想要减少

speaker: Unknown
en: The amount of false positive we have in the system.
zh: 系统中的误报数量。

speaker: Unknown
en: Coming up next is the remediation agent because everything we do we want to make actionable.
zh: 接下来登场的是修复智能体，因为我们所做的一切，我们都想让它可执行。

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't want to report about a vulnerability that eventually the developers, they don't know what they can do with that.
zh: 我们不想报告一个漏洞，结果开发人员却不知道能用它做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And coming after that is the reporting agent because everything needs to be reported.
zh: 在那之后是报告智能体，因为所有东西都需要被报告出来。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what makes us different?
zh: 那么，是什么让我们与众不同？

speaker: Unknown
en: And those are the points I urge you to check with every vendor out there trying to provide you with a solution or whether you want to implement a solution in-house for AI pen testing.
zh: 这些就是我强烈敦促你们去和市面上每一家试图向你提供解决方案的厂商核实的要点，或者说是你们想要在内部自建 AI 渗透测试解决方案时要核实的要点。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a huge industry right now.
zh: 现在这是一个巨大的行业。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I think the most important thing you need to remember is, and you already know that, especially the developers in the room, context is everything.
zh: 所以我认为你们最需要记住的一点是——而且你们已经知道了，尤其是在座的开发人员——上下文就是一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your LLM are as good as the context that you feed them with.
zh: 你的 LLM 的表现取决于你喂给它们的上下文的好坏。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what we're trying to do
zh: 所以我们正在尝试做的是

speaker: Unknown
en: We are not just taking our AI pen testing solution as a standalone.
zh: 我们不只是把我们的 AI 渗透测试解决方案当作一个独立的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: We actually feed it with data from all the previous scanners, okay?
zh: 我们实际上用之前所有扫描器的数据来喂养它，明白吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So the statics code scanner, the dynamic code scanner, all of the different engines are being combined together and they are being fed.
zh: 静态代码扫描器、动态代码扫描器，所有这些不同的引擎都被组合在一起，然后它们被喂给

speaker: Unknown
en: into our AI pentesting solution because that way we know how to tailor and we know how to guide the LLM where to look for.
zh: 我们的 AI 渗透测试解决方案，因为这样我们就知道如何定制，也知道如何引导 LLM 去哪里寻找。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as you know also from Mythos or from Fabel, when those models know where to look, the results are significantly better.
zh: 而且正如你也从 Mythos 或 Fabel 中知道的，当这些模型知道去哪里寻找时，结果会显著更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's one thing we're doing that is very unique and very differentiated.
zh: 所以这是我们在做的一件非常独特、非常有差异化的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And also what I want you to remember is that one solution is not enough.
zh: 另外我希望你记住的是，一个解决方案是不够的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The great thing about it is when you combine those things together and based on the data that we see both from the labs and from real data from customers, combining the data together is really what's important and you can't really
zh: 它的妙处在于，当你把这些东西结合在一起时——根据我们从实验室以及从客户真实数据中看到的数据——把数据结合在一起才是真正重要的，而你没法真正做到

speaker: Unknown
en: You can't really use just one of them.
zh: 你没法只单独使用其中一种。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are certain classes of vulnerabilities.
zh: 某些类别的漏洞，

speaker: Unknown
en: Dust is the best scanner for that because you have a set of really exhaustive payloads that you can send to your application.
zh: dust 是最好的扫描器，因为你有一套非常详尽的 payload 可以发送到你的应用程序。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's very good, for example, with cross-site scripting.
zh: 所以比如说，它非常擅长跨站脚本攻击。

speaker: Unknown
en: Dust for cross-site scripting is the best solution.
zh: dust 是针对跨站脚本攻击的最佳解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if you want, again, like business logic, then you should combine it with pentesting because it will be the best solution.
zh: 但是，如果你要对付的又是业务逻辑类的，那么你应该把它与渗透测试结合起来，因为那才会是最佳解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I think what I really want you to take from this
zh: 所以我认为我真正想让你带走的是

speaker: Unknown
en: If there is one thing I want you to take from here is to realize that the world is changing.
zh: 如果说我希望你们从这里带走一件事，那就是要意识到世界正在改变。

speaker: Unknown
en: You already know that.
zh: 你们已经知道这一点了。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what made you come here.
zh: 正是这一点让你们来到这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we used to test our application once every few months because the change and the velocity of the change was so slow.
zh: 但我们过去每隔几个月才测试一次我们的应用，因为变化以及变化的速度是如此缓慢。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we had people at the end that were reasoning about the application and about the change.
zh: 而且我们有专门的人员在最后对应用和变更进行推理。

speaker: Unknown
en: But that world does not longer exist, right?
zh: 但那个世界已经不复存在了，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Right now, we are pushing code to production 24-7, and we have LLMs that are trying to reason.
zh: 现在我们在全天候不停歇地向生产环境推送代码，而且我们有 LLM 在尝试推理

speaker: Unknown
en: about the application context and they are trying to break it continuously.
zh: 应用上下文，并且它们在持续不断地尝试突破它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some of them can do it in like as fast as four minutes, okay?
zh: 其中一些能做到快至四分钟，好吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: That's almost five times of the lecture of the session that I just did.
zh: 那几乎是我刚做的这场讲座时长的五倍。

speaker: Unknown
en: So when you're coming to look for new solutions for this problem, you have to ask yourself four questions, okay?
zh: 所以当你来为这个问题寻找新的解决方案时，你必须问自己四个问题，好吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: First of all,
zh: 首先，

speaker: Unknown
en: Do we run this solution in a continuous way, or is it just a point solution that we run every once in a while?
zh: 我们是持续地运行这个解决方案，还是它只是一个我们偶尔运行一次的定点解决方案？

speaker: Unknown
en: That's a major difference.
zh: 这是一个重大区别。

speaker: Unknown
en: Second, do they really reason about the application context?
zh: 第二，它们是否真正对应用上下文进行推理？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because given the nature of those LLM, application context is really where the new vulnerabilities are coming from.
zh: 因为鉴于那些 LLM 的本质，应用上下文正是新的漏洞来源所在。

speaker: Unknown
en: And third, what more context can they digest?
zh: 第三，它们还能消化哪些更多的上下文？

speaker: Unknown
en: How can they enrich the data?
zh: 它们如何丰富数据？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because the richer the data is, the better and, by the way, cheaper the LLM operation is going to be.
zh: 因为数据越丰富，LLM 的运行就会越好，顺便说一句，也会越便宜。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the fourth part is, do they really help me
zh: 第四部分是，它们是否真正帮助我

speaker: Unknown
en: To prove that there is a bug and to make sure that this is exploitable or that they just flag it as a bug.
zh: 证明存在一个漏洞，并确保它是可被利用的，还是它们只是将其标记为一个漏洞。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, so our goal is not only to help you find the bugs faster, but to actually do it better and cheaper and to help you as a developer or as the security people here focus on what matters most.
zh: 好的，所以我们的目标不仅是帮助你更快地找到漏洞，而是实际上做得更好、更便宜，并帮助你——作为开发者或作为在座的安全人员——专注于最重要的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: So thank you very much.
zh: 非常感谢大家。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I used to do it in every lecture.
zh: 我过去每次讲座都会做这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, my dream was to be a rock star, but I had to be a cyber entrepreneur.
zh: 你们知道，我的梦想是成为一名摇滚明星，但我不得不成为一名网络创业家。

speaker: Unknown
en: So instead of that, I'm going to take pictures.
zh: 所以作为替代，我要来拍照。

speaker: Unknown
en: So hands up, everyone.
zh: 大家举手。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, great.
zh: 好的，很好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you so much.
zh: 非常感谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm here for questions if you want.
zh: 如果你们有问题，我在这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Go for the boot.
zh: 去看 boot。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's very close here.
zh: 它就在非常近的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sneak.io, meet Evo, our new AI security offering.
zh: Sneak.io,来了解 Evo，我们新的 AI 安全产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you so much.
zh: 非常感谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。
